gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-karla: Impact Label hits heavy and commanding, each letter standing apart, the c's ends flaring like open pincers. Karla settles in beneath with a gaping c and a stocky middle band, modern and approachable.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-khula: Loud and isolated: Impact Label stands each letter apart, high-set x-height included, c ends flaring like open pincers. Khula would carry paragraph after paragraph without strain, its curves holding mouths open.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-krub: Heavy and isolated, Impact Label keeps its letters apart and its c ends pointing away like open pincers. Krub, contemporary and neutral, has a pronounced x-height that lets it run a little smaller.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-liter: Liter moves like a pencil that never presses harder, with wide mouths on its round forms. And Impact Label hits hard in the heading while Liter stays level beneath it.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-mada: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label spaces its letters apart and splays its c ends like open pincers. Mada then lets its curves refuse to close and its midzone tower, approachable and modern.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-martel-sans: Impact Label is all weight, a high-set x-height guiding letters that stand apart from one another. Martel Sans then carries paragraphs smoothly, generous openings in every curve and a high mean line keeping words legible.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-michroma: Open-pincer c ends give Impact Label its signature, set among heavy, commanding letters that stand apart. Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, its stubby ascenders and open curves sitting quietly beside that weight.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre draws wire-weight strokes with no shading, and its lowercase carries the stature of cast iron capitals. Under Impact Label, that sturdy lowercase can stay modest in size.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-mochiy-pop-p-: Loud and isolated: Impact Label stands each letter apart, its c ends flaring like open pincers. Mochiy Pop P One feels friendlier beside it, with wide gaps between letters and uniform strokes.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-montserrat-un: Impact Label hits hard, with heavy letters standing apart and a high-set x-height. Montserrat Underline settles into paragraphs with tubelike, constant-weight lines, breathing counters, and lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals.
